name: Ishiku Nagisa
source: During the day, she is the ideal nurse, cheerful and competent. She's always standing behind the protagonist, the doctor, in the examination room. She is family orientated and a good cook. She has a soft and gentle atmosphere and easily carried away by pleasure.
